'''Darrastead''' was a village with about 100 inhabitants on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It was led by elders. The villagers were often used as laborers by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] from [[Whisper Base]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darrastead appears in ''[[Operation: Shadowpoint]]'', a [[2014]] adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] gameline. It is a possible location as part of the adventure, with the villagers helping the players.
